name: compare-bad-input
description: Recorded 2026-10-22 from POST https://mcp.maxeds.org/v1/tools/compare_vendors (public, keyless; no request headers kept). One vendor sent straight to the API, bypassing the binding: vendor 400 with isError true; body verbatim. The binding rejects this input before any call.

body.text: {"error":"Pass 2 to 5 vendor names or websites in `vendors` (e.g. ['Glean', 'Notion'])."}
